Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Can’t make it to MagicCon Las Vegas? There’s always MagicCon Your House! Invite your closest friends and bitterest rivals to battle it out around your home gaming table with Festival in a Box: Las Vegas 2024. This amazing bundle brings the feeling of being at MagicCon straight to you.
This Festival in a Box is your first opportunity to get your hands on the Mystery Booster 2 Display Box. Inside you’ll find 24 packs of cards with up to nearly 200 set symbols, future sight frames, and the first white-border cards in 19 years, making every draft completely different. Plus you’ll get three Collector Boosters filled with awesome cards and jaw-dropping art.
In addition to all that, you’ll get the Li’l Legends Foil Edition Secret Lair Drop featuring some of the cutest legendary creatures you ever saw as well as a promo pack that includes an exclusive Convention Maro playtest promo card as well as three additional MagicCon promo cards.
So power up your neon lights and Viva Las MagicCon at home.
All cards are English only.
Contents
• 1x Mystery Booster 2 Display Box (24 boosters per display box)
• 1x The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Collector Booster
• 1x Wilds of Eldraine Collector Booster
• 1x Commander Masters Collector Booster
• 1x Li'l Legends Foil Edition Secret Lair drop:
• 1x Traditional foil Reya Dawnbringer
• 1x Traditional foil Orvar, the All-Form
• 1x Traditional foil Drana, the Last Bloodchief
• 1x Traditional foil Lavinia, Azorius Renegade
• 1x Traditional foil Omnath, Locus of Creation
• 1x MagicCon non-foil promo pack:
• 1x Ponder
• 1x Swords to Plowshares
• 1x Convention Maro playtest card
• 1x Plains

When purchasing this unique product, please keep in mind that this Secret Lair Drop Series Sealed Product will ship out to you after the seller receives the product directly from Wizards of the Coast.

The estimated time frame for sellers to receive stock is not fixed, so it could be anywhere between 1 - 10 weeks for delivery.
